newsitem.title: USA: Guerbet will not market EchoGen in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Guerbet will not market EchoGen in Europe.

text.p: Sonus Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Wednesday France's Guerbet SA would not exercise its option to market EchoGen Emulsion in Europe.
Sonus said in a statement Guerbet decided not to exercise its option "due to certain differences between the two companies that have prevented the parties from reaching a definitive agreement."
EchoGen is an agent used in ultrasound imaging.

Sonus has already begun negotiations with other companies that have expressed interest in European rights to EchoGen. Sonus said it expected to file a marketing authorization application with the European Medicines Evaluation Agency by year-end using U.S. Phase 3 data.
